**What this changes, and why.**

**Checklist**

- [ ] `node --test` passes
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -t .` passes
- [ ] A change under `app/` or `tools/` comes with a test that fails without it
- [ ] No local path, private address or one publisher's site has crept into the product
- [ ] Documentation touched by this change still matches the code, and every command
      printed in it was run
